**componentes.js**
```js
/**
 * Andrei | iu
 * Control principal de la interfaz mediante programación orientada a objetos.
 *
 * Nota sobre el namespace:
 * JavaScript no admite "|" dentro de un identificador. Por ello el namespace
 * técnico equivalente es `jocarsa.iu`.
 */
window.jocarsa = window.jocarsa || {};
window.jocarsa.iu = window.jocarsa.iu || {};

(() => {
  "use strict";

  class DOM {
    static uno(selector, contexto = document) {
      return contexto.querySelector(selector);
    }

    static todos(selector, contexto = document) {
      return [...contexto.querySelectorAll(selector)];
    }
  }

  class Utilidades {
    static hashTexto(texto) {
      let hash = 0;

      for (const caracter of texto) {
        hash = caracter.charCodeAt(0) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
      }

      return Math.abs(hash);
    }

    static colorTexto(texto) {
      return `hsl(${Utilidades.hashTexto(texto) % 360},55%,45%)`;
    }
  }

  class OrigenDatos {
    static async cargarJSON(url) {
      const respuesta = await fetch(url);

      if (!respuesta.ok) {
        throw new Error(url);
      }

      return respuesta.json();
    }
  }

  class EstadoIU {
    constructor() {
      this.menu = [];
      this.entidades = [];
      this.clientes = null;
      this.formulario = null;
      this.seleccion = "Listado";
    }
  }

  class FichaIU {
    static completar(elemento, texto) {
      const ficha = DOM.uno(".ficha", elemento);
      const etiqueta = DOM.uno(".etiqueta", elemento);

      ficha.textContent = texto.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      ficha.style.background = Utilidades.colorTexto(texto);
      etiqueta.textContent = texto;
    }
  }

  class ToastIU {
    constructor(selectorPila = "#toastStack") {
      this.selectorPila = selectorPila;
      this.iconos = {
        success: "✓",
        info: "i",
        warning: "!",
        danger: "×"
      };
    }

    obtenerPila() {
      let pila = DOM.uno(this.selectorPila);

      if (!pila) {
        pila = document.createElement("div");
        pila.id = this.selectorPila.replace(/^#/, "");
        pila.className = "ju-toast-stack";
        document.body.appendChild(pila);
      }

      return pila;
    }

    mostrar(tipo = "info", titulo = "Información", texto = "Operación realizada") {
      const pila = this.obtenerPila();
      const toast = document.createElement("article");

      toast.className = `ju-toast is-${tipo}`;
      toast.innerHTML = `
        <div class="ju-toast-icon">${this.iconos[tipo] || "i"}</div>
        <div>
          <p class="ju-toast-title">${titulo}</p>
          <p class="ju-toast-text">${texto}</p>
        </div>
        <button class="ju-toast-close" type="button">×</button>
      `;

      const cerrar = () => {
        toast.classList.add("is-leaving");
        setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 240);
      };

      DOM.uno("button", toast).addEventListener("click", cerrar);
      pila.appendChild(toast);
      setTimeout(cerrar, 5000);
    }
  }

  class ModalIU {
    constructor() {
      this.capa = DOM.uno("#juModal");
      this.titulo = DOM.uno("#juModalTitle");
      this.cuerpo = DOM.uno("#juModalBody");
      DOM.todos("[data-modal-close]", this.capa).forEach((nodo) => nodo.addEventListener("click", () => this.cerrar()));
    }
    abrir(titulo, contenido) {
      this.titulo.textContent = titulo;
      this.cuerpo.innerHTML = contenido;
      this.capa.classList.add("abierto");
      this.capa.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    }
    cerrar() {
      this.capa.classList.remove("abierto");
      this.capa.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    }
  }

  class DrawerIU {
    constructor(aplicacion) {
      this.aplicacion = aplicacion;
      this.panel = DOM.uno("#juDrawer");
      this.overlay = DOM.uno("#juDrawerOverlay");
      this.cuerpo = DOM.uno("#juDrawerBody");
      this.modo = DOM.uno("#juDrawerMode");
      this.titulo = DOM.uno("#juDrawerTitle");
      this.resizer = DOM.uno("#juDrawerResizer");
      this.anchoMinimo = 300;
      // El máximo real se calcula siempre como el 50% del viewport.
      this.anchoMaximo = () => Math.max(this.anchoMinimo, window.innerWidth * 0.5);
      DOM.uno("#juDrawerClose").addEventListener("click", () => this.cerrar());
      this.overlay.addEventListener("click", () => this.cerrar());
      this.resizer.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => this.iniciarRedimension(e));
      window.addEventListener("resize", () => this.ajustarAlViewport());
      this.actualizarColumnasFormulario();
    }
    abrirCrear() { this.renderFormulario("create", null); }
    abrirActualizar(registro) { this.renderFormulario("update", registro); }
    renderFormulario(modo, registro) {
      const esCrear = modo === "create";
      this.modo.textContent = esCrear ? "CREAR" : "ACTUALIZAR";
      this.titulo.textContent = esCrear ? "Nuevo cliente" : `Editar ${registro.nombre || "registro"}`;
      const campos = this.aplicacion.estado.formulario.campos;
      this.cuerpo.innerHTML = `<article class="ju-card"><form id="juDrawerForm" class="ju-form-grid">${campos.map(c => this.campoHTML(c, registro)).join("")}<div class="ju-form-full ju-button-row"><button class="ju-btn" type="submit">${esCrear ? "Crear" : "Guardar cambios"}</button><button class="ju-btn secondary" type="button" id="juDrawerCancel">Cancelar</button></div></form></article>`;
      DOM.uno("#juDrawerCancel").addEventListener("click", () => this.cerrar());
      DOM.uno("#juDrawerForm").addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
        const nuevo = {};
        campos.forEach(c => {
          if (c.tipo === "checkbox") nuevo[c.nombre] = fd.has(c.nombre);
          else if (c.tipo === "number") nuevo[c.nombre] = fd.get(c.nombre) === "" ? "" : Number(fd.get(c.nombre));
          else nuevo[c.nombre] = fd.get(c.nombre) ?? "";
        });
        if (esCrear) {
          const ids = this.aplicacion.estado.clientes.registros.map(r => Number(r.id) || 0);
          if (!nuevo.id) nuevo.id = Math.max(0, ...ids) + 1;
          this.aplicacion.estado.clientes.registros.push(nuevo);
          this.aplicacion.toast.mostrar("success", "Cliente creado", "El nuevo registro se ha añadido a la tabla.");
        } else {
          Object.assign(registro, nuevo);
          this.aplicacion.toast.mostrar("success", "Cliente actualizado", "Los cambios se muestran inmediatamente en la tabla.");
        }
        this.aplicacion.mostrarTabla(DOM.uno("#buscador").value);
        this.cerrar();
      });
      this.ajustarAlViewport();
      this.actualizarColumnasFormulario();
      this.panel.classList.add("abierto"); this.overlay.classList.add("abierto");
      this.panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false"); this.overlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      setTimeout(() => DOM.uno("input,select,textarea", this.cuerpo)?.focus(), 320);
    }
    campoHTML(c, registro) {
      const valor = registro?.[c.nombre] ?? "";
      const esc = (v) => String(v).replaceAll("&","&amp;").replaceAll('"',"&quot;").replaceAll("<","&lt;");
      if (c.tipo === "textarea") return `<label class="ju-form-full"><span>${c.etiqueta}</span><textarea name="${c.nombre}">${esc(valor)}</textarea></label>`;
      if (c.tipo === "select") return `<label><span>${c.etiqueta}</span><select name="${c.nombre}">${(c.opciones||[]).map(o=>`<option${o===valor?' selected':''}>${o}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>`;
      if (c.tipo === "checkbox") return `<label class="ju-check ju-form-full"><input type="checkbox" name="${c.nombre}"${valor?' checked':''}><span>${c.etiqueta}</span></label>`;
      return `<label><span>${c.etiqueta}</span><input name="${c.nombre}" type="${c.tipo || 'text'}" value="${esc(valor)}"${c.nombre==='id'?' min="1"':''}></label>`;
    }
    cerrar() { this.panel.classList.remove("abierto"); this.overlay.classList.remove("abierto"); this.panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true"); this.overlay.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true"); }
    iniciarRedimension(e) {
      e.preventDefault(); const inicio=e.clientX, anchoInicial=this.panel.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      this.resizer.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); document.body.classList.add("redimensionando-drawer"); this.panel.style.transition="none";
      const mover=(ev)=>{
        const ancho=Math.min(this.anchoMaximo(),Math.max(this.anchoMinimo,anchoInicial+(inicio-ev.clientX)));
        this.panel.style.setProperty("--drawer-width",`${ancho}px`);
        this.actualizarColumnasFormulario(ancho);
      };
      const fin=()=>{ this.resizer.removeEventListener("pointermove",mover); this.panel.style.transition=""; document.body.classList.remove("redimensionando-drawer"); };
      this.resizer.addEventListener("pointermove",mover); this.resizer.addEventListener("pointerup",fin,{once:true}); this.resizer.addEventListener("pointercancel",fin,{once:true});
    }
    actualizarColumnasFormulario(ancho = this.panel.getBoundingClientRect().width) {
      // <= 25% del navegador: una columna. > 25% y hasta 50%: dos columnas.
      this.panel.classList.toggle("ju-drawer-dos-columnas", ancho > window.innerWidth * 0.25);
    }
    ajustarAlViewport() {
      const actual = this.panel.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      const maximo = this.anchoMaximo();
      if (actual > maximo) {
        this.panel.style.setProperty("--drawer-width", `${maximo}px`);
        this.actualizarColumnasFormulario(maximo);
      } else {
        this.actualizarColumnasFormulario(actual);
      }
    }
  }

  class GestorColumnas {
    constructor() {
      this.anchoMinimo = 100;
      this.anchoMaximo = 600;
    }

    activar() {
      this.activarMinimizacion();
      this.activarSeparadores();
    }

    activarMinimizacion() {
      DOM.todos(".minimizar").forEach((boton) => {
        const columna = boton.closest("nav,section");
        columna.dataset.ancho = columna.getBoundingClientRect().width;

        boton.addEventListener("click", () => {
          this.alternarColumna(columna, boton);
        });
      });
    }

    alternarColumna(columna, boton) {
      if (columna.classList.contains("compacto")) {
        const ancho = parseFloat(columna.dataset.ancho) || 250;

        columna.classList.remove("compacto");
        columna.style.flexBasis = `${ancho}px`;
        columna.style.width = `${ancho}px`;
        boton.textContent = "◀";
        return;
      }

      columna.dataset.ancho = columna.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      columna.style.flexBasis = `${columna.dataset.ancho}px`;
      columna.style.width = `${columna.dataset.ancho}px`;

      void columna.offsetWidth;

      columna.classList.add("compacto");
      boton.textContent = "▶";
    }

    activarSeparadores() {
      DOM.todos(".separador").forEach((separador) => {
        separador.addEventListener("pointerdown", (evento) => {
          this.iniciarRedimension(separador, evento);
        });
      });
    }

    iniciarRedimension(separador, evento) {
      evento.preventDefault();

      const columna = separador.previousElementSibling;

      if (!columna || columna.classList.contains("compacto")) {
        return;
      }

      const inicio = evento.clientX;
      const anchoInicial = columna.getBoundingClientRect().width;

      columna.style.transition = "none";
      document.body.classList.add("redimensionando");
      separador.setPointerCapture(evento.pointerId);

      const mover = (eventoMovimiento) => {
        const ancho = Math.min(
          this.anchoMaximo,
          Math.max(this.anchoMinimo, anchoInicial + eventoMovimiento.clientX - inicio)
        );

        columna.style.width = `${ancho}px`;
        columna.style.flexBasis = `${ancho}px`;
        columna.dataset.ancho = ancho;
      };

      const terminar = () => {
        separador.removeEventListener("pointermove", mover);
        columna.style.transition = "";
        document.body.classList.remove("redimensionando");
      };

      separador.addEventListener("pointermove", mover);
      separador.addEventListener("pointerup", terminar, { once: true });
      separador.addEventListener("pointercancel", terminar, { once: true });
    }
  }

  class AplicacionIU {
    constructor() {
      this.estado = new EstadoIU();
      this.toast = new ToastIU();
      this.columnas = new GestorColumnas();
      this.modal = null;
      this.drawer = null;
    }

    async iniciar() {
      try {
        [
          this.estado.menu,
          this.estado.entidades,
          this.estado.clientes,
          this.estado.formulario
        ] = await Promise.all([
          OrigenDatos.cargarJSON("data/menu.json"),
          OrigenDatos.cargarJSON("data/entidades.json"),
          OrigenDatos.cargarJSON("data/clientes.json"),
          OrigenDatos.cargarJSON("data/datos.json")
        ]);

        this.modal = new ModalIU();
        this.drawer = new DrawerIU(this);
        this.renderMenu();
        this.renderEntidades();
        this.mostrarTabla();
        this.columnas.activar();
        this.activarEventos();
      } catch (error) {
        DOM.uno("#escenario").innerHTML = `
          <div class="panel">
            <h2>No se pudieron cargar los orígenes de datos</h2>
            <p>Sirve esta carpeta mediante HTTP, por ejemplo: <code>python3 -m http.server 8000</code></p>
            <pre>${error}</pre>
          </div>
        `;
      }
    }

    renderMenu() {
      const contenedor = DOM.uno("#navegacion .contenido-columna");
      contenedor.innerHTML = "";

      this.estado.menu.forEach((elemento, indice) => {
        const nodo = DOM.uno("#tpl-nav").content.cloneNode(true);
        const enlace = DOM.uno("a", nodo);

        FichaIU.completar(enlace, elemento.texto);
        enlace.classList.toggle("activo", Boolean(elemento.activo));
        enlace.dataset.indice = indice;

        enlace.addEventListener("click", (evento) => {
          evento.preventDefault();
          DOM.todos("#navegacion a").forEach((item) => item.classList.remove("activo"));
          enlace.classList.add("activo");
          this.mostrarTabla();
        });

        contenedor.appendChild(nodo);
      });
    }

    renderEntidades() {
      const contenedor = DOM.uno("#entidades .contenido-columna");
      contenedor.innerHTML = "";

      this.estado.entidades.forEach((elemento, indice) => {
        const nodo = DOM.uno("#tpl-card").content.cloneNode(true);
        const articulo = DOM.uno("article", nodo);

        FichaIU.completar(articulo, elemento.texto);
        articulo.classList.toggle("activo", elemento.texto === this.estado.seleccion);
        articulo.dataset.indice = indice;

        articulo.addEventListener("click", () => {
          this.estado.seleccion = elemento.texto;
          this.renderEntidades();
          this.mostrarVista(elemento.texto);
        });

        articulo.addEventListener("dragstart", (evento) => {
          evento.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", elemento.texto);
        });

        contenedor.appendChild(nodo);
      });
    }

    mostrarVista(vista) {
      if (vista === "Elemento" || vista === "Formulario") {
        this.mostrarFormularioUI();
      } else if (vista === "Login") {
        this.mostrarLoginDemo();
      } else if (vista === "Toasts") {
        this.mostrarToastsDemo();
      } else if (vista === "Entradas v5") {
        this.mostrarComponentesV5("demo-formulario.html", "Entradas v5");
      } else if (vista === "Reporting v5") {
        this.mostrarComponentesV5("demo-reporting.html", "Reporting v5");
      } else if (vista === "Modal / paneles") {
        this.mostrarModalPanelesDemo();
      } else {
        this.mostrarTabla();
      }
    }

    mostrarComponentesV5(archivo, titulo) {
      const escenario = DOM.uno("#escenario");
      escenario.replaceChildren();
      const marco = document.createElement("iframe");
      marco.className = "ju-componentes-frame";
      marco.title = titulo;
      marco.src = "componentes-v5/" + archivo;
      escenario.appendChild(marco);
    }

    mostrarTabla(filtro = "") {
      const datos = this.estado.clientes;
      const registros = datos.registros.filter((registro) =>
        Object.values(registro)
          .join(" ")
          .toLowerCase()
          .includes(filtro.toLowerCase())
      );
      const escenario = DOM.uno("#escenario");
      const tabla = document.createElement("table");

      escenario.innerHTML = "";
      tabla.innerHTML = `
        <caption>${datos.titulo}</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>${datos.columnas.map((columna) => `<th>${columna.etiqueta}</th>`).join("")}</tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody></tbody>
        <tfoot>
          <tr>
            <th colspan="${Math.max(1, datos.columnas.length - 1)}">Total</th>
            <td>${registros.length}</td>
          </tr>
        </tfoot>
      `;

      const cuerpo = DOM.uno("tbody", tabla);

      registros.forEach((registro) => {
        const fila = DOM.uno("#tpl-fila").content.cloneNode(true).querySelector("tr");

        datos.columnas.forEach((columna) => {
          const celda = document.createElement("td");
          celda.textContent = registro[columna.campo] ?? "";
          fila.appendChild(celda);
        });

        fila.classList.add("ju-row-editable");
        fila.title = "Clic para editar en el panel lateral";
        fila.addEventListener("click", () => this.drawer.abrirActualizar(registro));
        cuerpo.appendChild(fila);
      });

      escenario.appendChild(tabla);
    }

    mostrarFormularioUI() {
      const escenario = DOM.uno("#escenario");

      escenario.innerHTML = `
        <article class="ju-card">
          <h2>Librería · Formularios</h2>
          <p>Controles reutilizables con el lenguaje visual andrei-iu.</p>
          <form id="demoForm" class="ju-form-grid">
            <label>
              <span>Nombre</span>
              <input name="nombre" required>
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>Email</span>
              <input name="email" type="email" required>
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>Tipo</span>
              <select name="tipo">
                <option>Cliente</option>
                <option>Proveedor</option>
                <option>Alumno</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>Fecha</span>
              <input name="fecha" type="date">
            </label>
            <label class="ju-form-full">
              <span>Descripción</span>
              <textarea name="descripcion"></textarea>
            </label>
            <label class="ju-check ju-form-full">
              <input type="checkbox" name="activo">
              <span>Registro activo</span>
            </label>
            <div class="ju-form-full ju-button-row">
              <button class="ju-btn" type="submit">Guardar</button>
              <button class="ju-btn secondary" type="reset">Limpiar</button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </article>
      `;

      DOM.uno("#demoForm").addEventListener("submit", (evento) => {
        evento.preventDefault();
        this.toast.mostrar(
          "success",
          "Formulario guardado",
          "El evento submit se ha capturado correctamente."
        );
      });
    }

    mostrarLoginDemo() {
      const escenario = DOM.uno("#escenario");

      escenario.innerHTML = `
        <div class="ju-login-layout" style="margin:auto">
          <article class="ju-login-side">
            <div class="ju-login-brand">
              <img src="https://static.jocarsa.com/logos/white.svg" alt="">
              <h1 class="ju-login-product-title">Andrei | interfaz integrada</h1>
              <p>Pantalla de acceso basada en andrei-iu.</p>
            </div>
          </article>
          <article class="ju-login-card">
            <h2>Iniciar sesión</h2>
            <form id="loginDemo" class="ju-form-grid">
              <label class="ju-form-full">
                <span>Email</span>
                <input type="email" required>
              </label>
              <label class="ju-form-full">
                <span>Contraseña</span>
                <input type="password" required>
              </label>
              <label class="ju-check ju-form-full">
                <input type="checkbox">
                <span>Mantener sesión</span>
              </label>
              <div class="ju-form-full ju-login-actions">
                <button class="ju-btn">Entrar</button>
                <a class="ju-text-link" href="login.html">Abrir pantalla completa</a>
              </div>
            </form>
          </article>
        </div>
      `;

      DOM.uno("#loginDemo").addEventListener("submit", (evento) => {
        evento.preventDefault();
        this.toast.mostrar(
          "success",
          "Acceso simulado",
          "Login capturado como componente reutilizable."
        );
      });
    }

    mostrarToastsDemo() {
      const escenario = DOM.uno("#escenario");

      escenario.innerHTML = `
        <article class="ju-card">
          <h2>Librería · Toasts</h2>
          <p>Mensajes emergentes reutilizables con autocierre y cierre manual.</p>
          <div class="ju-button-row">
            <button class="ju-btn" data-t="success">Éxito</button>
            <button class="ju-btn secondary" data-t="info">Información</button>
            <button class="ju-btn secondary" data-t="warning">Aviso</button>
            <button class="ju-btn secondary" data-t="danger">Error</button>
          </div>
        </article>
      `;

      const titulos = {
        success: "Correcto",
        info: "Información",
        warning: "Revisar",
        danger: "Error"
      };

      DOM.todos("[data-t]", escenario).forEach((boton) => {
        boton.addEventListener("click", () => {
          this.toast.mostrar(
            boton.dataset.t,
            titulos[boton.dataset.t],
            "Ejemplo de mensaje emergente de la librería."
          );
        });
      });
    }

    mostrarModalPanelesDemo() {
      const escenario = DOM.uno("#escenario");
      escenario.innerHTML = `<article class="ju-card"><h2>Librería · Modal y panel lateral</h2><p>Dos patrones reutilizables para acciones que no deben sustituir el contenido del escenario.</p><div class="ju-showcase-grid"><div class="ju-showcase-box"><h3>Ventana modal</h3><p>Bloquea temporalmente la interfaz para confirmaciones, avisos o contenido focal.</p><button class="ju-btn" id="demoModal">Abrir modal</button></div><div class="ju-showcase-box"><h3>Panel lateral</h3><p>Entra desde la derecha, mantiene visible el contexto y puede redimensionarse arrastrando su borde izquierdo.</p><button class="ju-btn" id="demoDrawer">Abrir panel de creación</button></div></div></article>`;
      DOM.uno("#demoModal").addEventListener("click", () => {
        this.modal.abrir("Ejemplo de ventana modal", `<p>Esta es la nueva ventana modal reutilizable de <strong>Andrei | iu</strong>.</p><p>Se puede cerrar con el botón ×, haciendo clic fuera o pulsando Escape.</p><div class="ju-button-row"><button class="ju-btn" id="modalAceptar">Aceptar</button></div>`);
        DOM.uno("#modalAceptar").addEventListener("click", () => this.modal.cerrar());
      });
      DOM.uno("#demoDrawer").addEventListener("click", () => this.drawer.abrirCrear());
    }

    activarEventos() {
      DOM.uno("#buscador").addEventListener("input", (evento) => {
        this.mostrarTabla(evento.target.value);
      });

      DOM.uno("#nuevo").addEventListener("click", () => {
        this.drawer.abrirCrear();
      });

      const escenario = DOM.uno("#escenario");

      escenario.addEventListener("dragover", (evento) => {
        evento.preventDefault();
        escenario.classList.add("drag-over");
      });

      escenario.addEventListener("dragleave", () => {
        escenario.classList.remove("drag-over");
      });

      escenario.addEventListener("drop", (evento) => {
        evento.preventDefault();
        escenario.classList.remove("drag-over");

        const vista = evento.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain");
        this.estado.seleccion = vista;
        this.renderEntidades();
        this.mostrarVista(vista);
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", (evento) => {
        if (evento.key === "Escape") {
          this.drawer?.cerrar();
          this.modal?.cerrar();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  window.jocarsa.iu.DOM = DOM;
  window.jocarsa.iu.Utilidades = Utilidades;
  window.jocarsa.iu.OrigenDatos = OrigenDatos;
  window.jocarsa.iu.EstadoIU = EstadoIU;
  window.jocarsa.iu.FichaIU = FichaIU;
  window.jocarsa.iu.ToastIU = ToastIU;
  window.jocarsa.iu.ModalIU = ModalIU;
  window.jocarsa.iu.DrawerIU = DrawerIU;
  window.jocarsa.iu.GestorColumnas = GestorColumnas;
  window.jocarsa.iu.AplicacionIU = AplicacionIU;

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    window.jocarsa.iu.aplicacion = new AplicacionIU();
    window.jocarsa.iu.aplicacion.iniciar();
  });
})();
/* =========================================================
   Prompt IA flotante · Ollama local · v2
   ========================================================= */
(() => {
  const iniciarPromptIA = () => {
    const prompt = document.querySelector('#juAiPrompt');
    const drag = document.querySelector('#juAiDrag');
    const input = document.querySelector('#juAiInput');
    const mic = document.querySelector('#juAiMic');
    const send = document.querySelector('#juAiSend');
    const status = document.querySelector('#juAiStatus');
    const escenario = document.querySelector('#escenario');
    const minimizar = document.querySelector('#juAiMinimize');
    const resizer = document.querySelector('#juAiResizer');
    const speakToggle = document.querySelector('#juAiSpeak');
    if (!prompt || !drag || !input || !mic || !send || !status || !escenario || !minimizar || !resizer || !speakToggle) return;

    let enviando=false, reconocimiento=null, escuchando=false;
    const escapeHTML = t => String(t).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
    const inline = t => escapeHTML(t)
      .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code>$1</code>')
      .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>')
      .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>');

    // Markdown ligero, incluyendo tablas, sin dependencias externas.
    const markdown = md => {
      md=String(md||'').replace(/\r/g,'').replace(/\u00a0/g,' ').replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g,'').trim();
      // Los LLM envuelven a veces TODO el Markdown en ```markdown ... ```.
      // Lo desenvolvemos antes de proteger los bloques de código reales.
      md=md.replace(/```(?:markdown|md)\s*\n([\s\S]*?)```/gi,(_,body)=>body.trim());
      const normalizeFenceTable = body => String(body||'')
        .replace(/[｜¦│]/g,'|').replace(/[‐‑‒–—−]/g,'-')
        .replace(/\u00a0/g,' ').replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g,'').trim();
      const fenceLooksLikeTable = body => {
        const ls=normalizeFenceTable(body).split('\n').filter(x=>x.trim());
        if(ls.length<2 || !ls[0].includes('|')) return false;
        const cells=x=>x.trim().replace(/^\s*\|/,'').replace(/\|\s*$/,'').split('|').map(v=>v.trim());
        const sep=cells(ls[1]);
        return cells(ls[0]).length>=2 && sep.length>=2 && sep.every(v=>/^:?-{2,}:?$/.test(v.replace(/\s+/g,'')));
      };
      // Algunos modelos meten una tabla Markdown dentro de un fence ``` sin lenguaje.
      // Si el contenido tiene estructura de tabla, lo sacamos del fence; el código real se conserva.
      md=md.replace(/```([^\n]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g,(all,lang,body)=>{
        if((!lang.trim() || /^(text|txt)$/i.test(lang.trim())) && fenceLooksLikeTable(body)) return normalizeFenceTable(body);
        return all;
      });
      const code=[];
      md=md.replace(/```([^\n]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g,(_,lang,body)=>`@@CODE${code.push({lang,body})-1}@@`);
      const lines=md.split('\n'), out=[];
      for(let i=0;i<lines.length;){
        const line=lines[i];
        // Tabla Markdown GFM. No exigimos que las filas terminen en |, porque
        // los LLM suelen omitir esa barra final. La segunda fila debe estar
        // formada exclusivamente por separadores --- / :--- / ---: / :---:.
        const normalizaTabla = x => String(x||'')
          .replace(/[｜¦│]/g,'|')
          .replace(/[‐‑‒–—−]/g,'-')
          .replace(/\u00a0/g,' ')
          .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g,'');
        const tableCells = x => normalizaTabla(x).trim().replace(/^\s*\|/, '').replace(/\|\s*$/, '').split('|').map(v=>v.trim());
        const isTableRow = x => normalizaTabla(x).includes('|') && tableCells(x).length >= 2;
        const isTableSeparator = x => {
          if(!isTableRow(x)) return false;
          const c=tableCells(x);
          return c.length>=2 && c.every(v=>/^:?-+:?$/.test(v.replace(/\s+/g,'')));
        };
        if(isTableRow(line) && i+1<lines.length && isTableSeparator(lines[i+1])){
          const heads=tableCells(line); i+=2; const rows=[];
          while(i<lines.length && lines[i].trim() && isTableRow(lines[i]) && !isTableSeparator(lines[i])) rows.push(tableCells(lines[i++]));
          out.push('<div class="ju-ai-table-wrap"><table><thead><tr>'+heads.map(x=>`<th>${inline(x)}</th>`).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+rows.map(r=>'<tr>'+heads.map((_,j)=>`<td>${inline(r[j]||'')}</td>`).join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>'); continue;
        }
        let m;
        if((m=line.match(/^###\s+(.+)/))) out.push(`<h3>${inline(m[1])}</h3>`);
        else if((m=line.match(/^##\s+(.+)/))) out.push(`<h2>${inline(m[1])}</h2>`);
        else if((m=line.match(/^#\s+(.+)/))) out.push(`<h1>${inline(m[1])}</h1>`);
        else if((m=line.match(/^>\s?(.+)/))) out.push(`<blockquote>${inline(m[1])}</blockquote>`);
        else if(/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(line)){
          let items=[]; while(i<lines.length && /^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*[-*]\s+/,''));
          out.push('<ul>'+items.map(x=>`<li>${inline(x)}</li>`).join('')+'</ul>'); continue;
        } else if(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(line)){
          let items=[]; while(i<lines.length && /^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(lines[i])) items.push(lines[i++].replace(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/,''));
          out.push('<ol>'+items.map(x=>`<li>${inline(x)}</li>`).join('')+'</ol>'); continue;
        } else if(/^@@CODE\d+@@$/.test(line.trim())){
          const n=+line.match(/\d+/)[0], c=code[n]; out.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHTML(c.body)}</code></pre>`);
        } else if(line.trim()) out.push(`<p>${inline(line)}</p>`);
        i++;
      }
      return out.join('\n');
    };

    const autoResize=()=>{input.style.height='auto';input.style.height=Math.min(input.scrollHeight,150)+'px'};
    const fijar=(left,top)=>{const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(),m=8;return {left:Math.max(m,Math.min(left,window.innerWidth-r.width-m)),top:Math.max(62,Math.min(top,window.innerHeight-r.height-m))}};
    const convertirPosicion=()=>{const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect();prompt.style.transform='none';prompt.style.bottom='auto';prompt.style.left=r.left+'px';prompt.style.top=r.top+'px'};

    drag.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
      if(e.button!==0 || e.target.closest('button')) return;
      convertirPosicion(); const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(), ox=e.clientX-r.left, oy=e.clientY-r.top;
      prompt.classList.add('is-dragging'); drag.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      const mover=ev=>{const p=fijar(ev.clientX-ox,ev.clientY-oy);prompt.style.left=p.left+'px';prompt.style.top=p.top+'px'};
      const soltar=ev=>{prompt.classList.remove('is-dragging');try{drag.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId)}catch{};drag.removeEventListener('pointermove',mover);drag.removeEventListener('pointerup',soltar);drag.removeEventListener('pointercancel',soltar)};
      drag.addEventListener('pointermove',mover);drag.addEventListener('pointerup',soltar);drag.addEventListener('pointercancel',soltar);
    });

    minimizar.addEventListener('click',e=>{
      e.stopPropagation(); convertirPosicion(); prompt.classList.toggle('is-minimized');
      minimizar.textContent=prompt.classList.contains('is-minimized')?'□':'—'; minimizar.title=prompt.classList.contains('is-minimized')?'Restaurar':'Minimizar';
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(),p=fijar(r.left,r.top);prompt.style.left=p.left+'px';prompt.style.top=p.top+'px'});
    });

    resizer.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
      e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();convertirPosicion();
      const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(), sx=e.clientX,sy=e.clientY,sw=r.width,sh=r.height;
      resizer.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      const mover=ev=>{prompt.style.width=Math.max(360,Math.min(sw+ev.clientX-sx,window.innerWidth-r.left-8))+'px';prompt.style.height=Math.max(82,Math.min(sh+ev.clientY-sy,window.innerHeight-r.top-8))+'px'};
      const fin=ev=>{try{resizer.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId)}catch{};resizer.removeEventListener('pointermove',mover);resizer.removeEventListener('pointerup',fin);resizer.removeEventListener('pointercancel',fin)};
      resizer.addEventListener('pointermove',mover);resizer.addEventListener('pointerup',fin);resizer.addEventListener('pointercancel',fin);
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!prompt.style.top)return;const r=prompt.getBoundingClientRect(),p=fijar(r.left,r.top);prompt.style.left=p.left+'px';prompt.style.top=p.top+'px'});

    const enviar=async()=>{
      const texto=input.value.trim(); if(!texto||enviando)return; enviando=true;send.disabled=true;mic.disabled=true;status.textContent='Ollama está generando el nuevo contenido del escenario…';
      try{
        const respuesta=await fetch('ollama.php',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({mensaje:texto})});
        if(!respuesta.ok)throw new Error(`HTTP ${respuesta.status}`); const datos=await respuesta.json(); const contenido=datos.respuesta??'No he podido responder.';
        escenario.innerHTML='<article class="ju-ai-result">'+markdown(contenido)+'</article>';
        if(speakToggle.checked && 'speechSynthesis' in window){
          speechSynthesis.cancel();
          const voz=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(String(contenido).replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g,' ').replace(/\|/g,' ').replace(/[#*_>`~-]/g,' '));
          voz.lang='es-ES'; speechSynthesis.speak(voz);
        }
        status.textContent='Escenario actualizado.';input.value='';autoResize();setTimeout(()=>{if(status.textContent==='Escenario actualizado.')status.textContent=''},2200);
      }catch(error){console.error(error);status.textContent='No se ha podido conectar con Ollama.'}
      finally{enviando=false;send.disabled=false;mic.disabled=false;input.focus()}
    };
    send.addEventListener('click',enviar);input.addEventListener('input',autoResize);input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){e.preventDefault();enviar()}});
    const SpeechRecognition=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if(!SpeechRecognition){mic.disabled=true;mic.title='Reconocimiento de voz no disponible en este navegador'}else mic.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(escuchando&&reconocimiento){reconocimiento.stop();return} reconocimiento=new SpeechRecognition();reconocimiento.lang='es-ES';reconocimiento.interimResults=false;reconocimiento.continuous=false;
      reconocimiento.onstart=()=>{escuchando=true;mic.classList.add('is-listening');status.textContent='Escuchando…'};
      reconocimiento.onresult=evento=>{const texto=evento.results[0][0].transcript;input.value=input.value.trim()?input.value.trim()+' '+texto:texto;autoResize();input.focus()};
      reconocimiento.onerror=evento=>{console.error('Error de reconocimiento:',evento.error);status.textContent='No se ha podido reconocer la voz.'};
      reconocimiento.onend=()=>{escuchando=false;mic.classList.remove('is-listening');if(status.textContent==='Escuchando…')status.textContent=''};reconocimiento.start();
    });
    autoResize();
  };
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',iniciarPromptIA);else iniciarPromptIA();
})();

```js
/**
 * Andrei | iu · demostraciones
 * Namespace técnico: jocarsa.iu
 */
window.jocarsa = window.jocarsa || {};
window.jocarsa.iu = window.jocarsa.iu || {};

(() => {
  "use strict";

  class ToastDemo {
    constructor(selectorPila = "#toastStack") {
      this.pila = document.querySelector(selectorPila);
      this.iconos = {
        success: "✓",
        info: "i",
        warning: "!",
        danger: "×"
      };
    }

    mostrar(tipo = "info", titulo = "Información", texto = "Mensaje de ejemplo") {
      if (!this.pila) {
        return;
      }

      const toast = document.createElement("article");
      toast.className = `ju-toast is-${tipo}`;
      toast.innerHTML = `
        <div class="ju-toast-icon">${this.iconos[tipo] || "i"}</div>
        <div>
          <p class="ju-toast-title">${titulo}</p>
          <p class="ju-toast-text">${texto}</p>
        </div>
        <button class="ju-toast-close" type="button" aria-label="Cerrar">×</button>
      `;

      const cerrar = () => {
        toast.classList.add("is-leaving");
        setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 240);
      };

      toast.querySelector(".ju-toast-close").addEventListener("click", cerrar);
      this.pila.appendChild(toast);
      setTimeout(cerrar, 5000);
    }
  }

  class DemoIU {
    constructor() {
      this.toast = new ToastDemo();
      this.textos = {
        success: ["Guardado correctamente", "La operación se ha completado."],
        info: ["Información", "Este es un mensaje informativo."],
        warning: ["Revisión necesaria", "Conviene revisar los datos antes de continuar."],
        danger: ["Operación fallida", "No se ha podido completar la operación."]
      };
    }

    iniciar() {
      document.addEventListener("click", (evento) => {
        const boton = evento.target.closest("[data-toast]");

        if (!boton) {
          return;
        }

        const tipo = boton.dataset.toast;
        this.toast.mostrar(tipo, ...this.textos[tipo]);
      });

      document.getElementById("formDemo")?.addEventListener("submit", (evento) => {
        evento.preventDefault();
        this.toast.mostrar(
          "success",
          "Formulario guardado",
          "El evento submit se ha capturado correctamente."
        );
      });
    }
  }

  window.jocarsa.iu.ToastDemo = ToastDemo;
  window.jocarsa.iu.DemoIU = DemoIU;

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    window.jocarsa.iu.demo = new DemoIU();
    window.jocarsa.iu.demo.iniciar();
  });
})();

**responsive-vistas.js**
```js
(()=>{'use strict';
const mq=matchMedia('(max-width:700px)');
function responsive(){const z=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--ju-content-scale'))||1;return mq.matches||innerWidth/z<=700;}
function setupMenus(){
 document.querySelectorAll('body.jocarsa-iu > main > nav, body.jocarsa-iu > main > section#entidades').forEach((menu,i)=>{
  if(menu.dataset.juAccordion)return;menu.dataset.juAccordion='1';menu.classList.add('ju-mobile-menu');
  const title=menu.querySelector(':scope > .titulo-columna');
  const toggle=document.createElement('button');toggle.type='button';toggle.className='ju-mobile-menu-toggle';toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  toggle.innerHTML='<span class="ju-hamburger" aria-hidden="true">☰</span><span></span><span aria-hidden="true">▾</span>';
  toggle.children[1].textContent=(title?.textContent|| (i?'Secciones':'Navegación')).trim();
  const id='ju-menu-body-'+i;const body=document.createElement('div');body.className='ju-mobile-menu-body';body.id=id;
  toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls',id);
  // Move nodes, never clone: preserves their listeners and behavior.
  [...menu.childNodes].forEach(n=>body.appendChild(n));menu.append(toggle,body);
  const set=open=>{menu.classList.toggle('ju-menu-open',open);toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));};
  toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>set(!menu.classList.contains('ju-menu-open')));
  menu.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('a'))set(false)});
 });
}
const esc=s=>String(s??'').trim();
function setupTable(table){
 if(table.dataset.juViews)return;table.dataset.juViews='1';
 const wrapper=document.createElement('div');wrapper.className='ju-table-adapter';table.before(wrapper);wrapper.append(table);
 const toolbar=document.createElement('div');toolbar.className='ju-table-views';toolbar.setAttribute('role','group');toolbar.setAttribute('aria-label','Vista de datos');
 const modes=[['table','Tabla'],['cards','Tarjetas'],['tree','Árbol']];const buttons={};
 for(const [mode,label] of modes){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=label;b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');b.addEventListener('click',()=>{wrapper.dataset.manualView=mode;setMode(mode)});toolbar.append(b);buttons[mode]=b}
 const cards=document.createElement('div');cards.className='ju-table-cards';const tree=document.createElement('div');tree.className='ju-table-tree';wrapper.prepend(toolbar);wrapper.append(cards,tree);
 let active='table';
 function setMode(mode){active=mode;wrapper.dataset.view=mode;for(const [k,b] of Object.entries(buttons))b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(k===mode));if(mode!=='table')render();}
 function render(){
  const head=[...table.querySelectorAll('thead th')].map(e=>esc(e.textContent));
  const rows=[...table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')];cards.replaceChildren();tree.replaceChildren();
  rows.forEach((tr,index)=>{
   const cells=[...tr.children].filter(e=>e.matches('td,th'));
   if(!cells.length)return;
   const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='ju-data-card';
   const summary=document.createElement('strong');summary.className='ju-data-card-title';summary.textContent=esc(cells[1]?.textContent)||esc(cells[0]?.textContent)||'Registro '+(index+1);card.append(summary);
   const dl=document.createElement('dl');
   cells.forEach((cell,j)=>{const dt=document.createElement('dt');dt.textContent=head[j]||cell.getAttribute('data-label')||'Campo '+(j+1);const dd=document.createElement('dd');
    // Preserve interactivity: controls are not moved or cloned. Provide a button that switches to the real table when a row has controls.
    if(cell.querySelector('button,input,select,textarea,a')){dd.textContent=esc(cell.textContent)||'Acción disponible en tabla';const jump=document.createElement('button');jump.type='button';jump.textContent='Abrir en tabla';jump.addEventListener('click',()=>{wrapper.dataset.manualView='table';setMode('table');tr.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})});dd.append(' ',jump)}else dd.textContent=esc(cell.textContent)||'—';dl.append(dt,dd)});
   card.append(dl);cards.append(card);
   const detail=document.createElement('details');detail.className='ju-tree-item';const title=document.createElement('summary');title.textContent=summary.textContent;detail.append(title);
   const copy=dl.cloneNode(true);copy.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.remove());detail.append(copy);tree.append(detail);
  });
 }
 const auto=()=>{if(!wrapper.dataset.manualView)setMode(responsive()?'cards':'table');else if(responsive()&&wrapper.dataset.manualView==='table')setMode('cards');else setMode(wrapper.dataset.manualView)};
 auto();window.addEventListener('resize',auto,{passive:true});
 // Table rows may be rendered asynchronously. Observe only the original table.
 let queued=false;new MutationObserver(()=>{if(queued)return;queued=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{queued=false;if(active!=='table')render()})}).observe(table,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true});
 document.addEventListener('ju-a11y-scale-change',auto);
}
function init(){setupMenus();document.querySelectorAll('table:not([data-ju-views])').forEach(setupTable);const root=document.querySelector('main')||document.body;new MutationObserver(()=>{setupMenus();root.querySelectorAll('table:not([data-ju-views])').forEach(setupTable)}).observe(root,{childList:true,subtree:true});}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);else init();
})();
```
**teclado.js**
```js
/* Capa de accesibilidad incremental. No sustituye los eventos existentes. */
(()=>{'use strict';
const selector='a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([type="hidden"]):not([disabled]),select:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),summary,[role="button"],[role="option"],[role="treeitem"],[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
const visible=el=>!!el.getClientRects().length&&!el.closest('[hidden],[inert],[aria-hidden="true"]');
const interactive=el=>el.matches(selector)&&visible(el);
function upgrade(){
 // Los artículos del menú y las tarjetas se generan dinámicamente.
 document.querySelectorAll('#entidades article, #navegacion article, #escenario article[draggable], .contenido-columna article').forEach(el=>{
  if(el.querySelector('a[href],button,[tabindex="0"]'))return;
  if(!el.hasAttribute('tabindex'))el.tabIndex=0;
  if(!el.hasAttribute('role'))el.setAttribute('role','button');
  if(!el.hasAttribute('aria-label'))el.setAttribute('aria-label',el.textContent.trim()||'Abrir elemento');
 });
 // Las filas no reemplazan a los controles de sus celdas; pueden recibir foco para lectura.
 document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr').forEach(tr=>{
  if(!tr.hasAttribute('tabindex'))tr.tabIndex=0;
  if(!tr.hasAttribute('aria-label'))tr.setAttribute('aria-label',[...tr.cells].map(c=>c.innerText.trim()).join(' · '));
 });
 document.querySelectorAll('[role="treeitem"],[role="option"]').forEach(el=>{if(!el.hasAttribute('tabindex'))el.tabIndex=0});
}
function activate(el){if(el.matches('a[href],button,input,select,textarea,summary'))return false;el.click();return true}
function move(e,group){
 const all=[...group.querySelectorAll(selector)].filter(interactive);
 const i=all.indexOf(e.target);if(i<0||all.length<2)return;
 let n=i;
 if(e.key==='Home')n=0;else if(e.key==='End')n=all.length-1;
 else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowRight')n=(i+1)%all.length;
 else if(e.key==='ArrowUp'||e.key==='ArrowLeft')n=(i-1+all.length)%all.length;
 else return;
 e.preventDefault();all[n].focus();
}
function init(){
 const main=document.getElementById('contenido-principal');
 document.querySelector('.ju-skip-link')?.addEventListener('click',()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>main?.focus({preventScroll:true})));
 upgrade();
 const observer=new MutationObserver(()=>{if(!document.documentElement.dataset.juUpgrading){document.documentElement.dataset.juUpgrading='1';upgrade();delete document.documentElement.dataset.juUpgrading}});
 observer.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.defaultPrevented||e.altKey||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)return;
  const el=e.target;if(!(el instanceof Element))return;
  if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&el.matches('[role="button"],article[tabindex="0"],tr[tabindex="0"]')){
   if(el.matches('tr'))return; e.preventDefault();activate(el);return;
  }
  if(e.key==='Escape'){
   const panel=document.querySelector('.ju-a11y-panel:not([hidden])');if(panel){document.querySelector('.ju-a11y-button')?.click();document.querySelector('.ju-a11y-button')?.focus();return}
  }
  if(!['ArrowDown','ArrowUp','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End'].includes(e.key))return;
  if(el.matches('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]'))return;
  // Flechas para navegar elementos de menús, filas y controles de formulario agrupados.
  const group=el.closest('#navegacion,#entidades,.ju-integrated-menu,[role="menu"],[role="listbox"],[role="tree"],.ju-a11y-panel,table,form,.jocarsa-demo section');
  if(group)move(e,group);
 });
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);else init();
})();

#### 013-andrei-iu-accesibilidad-v7-ayudas
**README-INTEGRACION.md**
```markdown
# Integración de 013-jocarsa-componentes v5 en 005-Habla

Los módulos **Entradas v5** y **Reporting v5** aparecen ahora como dos elementos de la segunda columna de la aplicación principal. Se eliminan los accesos adicionales de la cabecera.

Al pulsar un elemento se carga la demostración correspondiente en el escenario central sin cambiar de página, conservando navegación, buscador, asistente local, modales y paneles existentes.

Las demos utilizan un iframe de aislamiento CSS/JavaScript para impedir que la librería v5 modifique controles de la aplicación anfitriona; el iframe no contiene otra copia de la navegación de Habla. Los colores, chaflanes, fondos, tipografía y espaciado se ajustan a jocarsa-iu.

Se conservan las páginas de demo autónomas y todos los archivos originales para compatibilidad.

Iniciar: `python3 -m http.server 8000` y abrir `/index.html`.


## v4 - Menús desplegables y vistas de tablas
Menús responsive plegables, botones a anchura completa y vistas Tabla/Tarjetas/Árbol. Las tablas originales permanecen en DOM; la vista móvil por defecto es Tarjetas. Las acciones complejas se abren en la tabla original. Los datos asíncronos se actualizan mediante MutationObserver.

## v5 — Accesibilidad por teclado
- Nuevo `css/teclado.css` y `js/teclado.js` sin sustituir los scripts originales.
- Enlace visible al recibir foco para saltar al contenido; logo de cabecera operable con Enter/Espacio.
- Indicador de foco de alto contraste y navegación con flechas/Home/End en menús.
- Tarjetas dinámicas de entidades enfocables y activables con Enter/Espacio.
- Títulos descriptivos por página.
- Pendiente: auditoría manual de todos los modales, operaciones de arrastre y controles de terceros para garantizar operabilidad completa con teclado.

**ollama.php**
```php
<?php

header("Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8");


// Recoger JSON enviado desde JavaScript

$entrada = json_decode(
    file_get_contents("php://input"),
    true
);

$mensaje = trim($entrada["mensaje"] ?? "");

if ($mensaje === "") {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(["respuesta" => "El prompt está vacío."]);
    exit;
}


// Petición para Ollama

$datos = [
    "model" => "phi3:mini",

    "prompt" => $mensaje,

    "stream" => false
];


// Conectar con Ollama

$ch = curl_init(
    "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
);

curl_setopt(
    $ch,
    CURLOPT_POST,
    true
);

curl_setopt(
    $ch,
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER,
    [
        "Content-Type: application/json"
    ]
);

curl_setopt(
    $ch,
    CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS,
    json_encode($datos)
);

curl_setopt(
    $ch,
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER,
    true
);


// Ejecutar

$respuesta = curl_exec($ch);

curl_close($ch);


// Decodificar respuesta de Ollama

$resultado = json_decode(
    $respuesta,
    true
);


// Obtener únicamente el texto

$texto = $resultado["response"] ?? "No he podido responder.";


// Responder al navegador

echo json_encode([
    "respuesta" => $texto
]);

**jocarsa-extension.js**
```js
(()=>{'use strict';
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
const iso=d=>`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
const notify=el=>{el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};
const monday=d=>{const x=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate());x.setDate(x.getDate()-(x.getDay()+6)%7);return x;};
function weekISO(d){const x=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()));x.setUTCDate(x.getUTCDate()+4-(x.getUTCDay()||7));const year=x.getUTCFullYear();const start=new Date(Date.UTC(year,0,1));return `${year}-W${pad(Math.ceil((((x-start)/86400000)+1)/7))}`;}
function dateFromWeek(s){const m=/^(\d{4})-W(\d{2})$/.exec(s);if(!m)return new Date();const jan4=new Date(+m[1],0,4);const x=monday(jan4);x.setDate(x.getDate()+(+m[2]-1)*7);return x;}
function enhanceDate(input){if(input.dataset.jocarsaPicker||input.disabled||!['date','time','datetime-local','month','week'].includes(input.type))return;
input.dataset.jocarsaPicker='1';const type=input.type;const wrap=document.createElement('span');wrap.className='jocarsa-date-wrap';input.before(wrap);wrap.append(input);input.classList.add('jocarsa-date-source');input.tabIndex=-1;input.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
const trigger=document.createElement('button');trigger.type='button';trigger.className='jocarsa-date-display';trigger.setAttribute('aria-label',`Seleccionar ${type}`);wrap.append(trigger);
const format=()=>{const v=input.value;if(!v)return {text:'Seleccionar '+({date:'fecha',time:'hora','datetime-local':'fecha y hora',month:'mes',week:'semana'}[type]),empty:true};if(type==='time')return{text:v};if(type==='month'){const [y,m]=v.split('-');return{text:new Date(+y,+m-1,1).toLocaleDateString('es-ES',{month:'long',year:'numeric'})};}if(type==='week')return{text:v};if(type==='datetime-local'){const [d,t]=v.split('T');return{text:`${d.split('-').reverse().join('/')} · ${t}`};}return{text:v.split('-').reverse().join('/')};};
function sync(){const f=format();trigger.textContent=f.text;trigger.classList.toggle('empty',!!f.empty);trigger.disabled=input.disabled;}
input.addEventListener('input',sync);input.addEventListener('change',sync);sync();
trigger.addEventListener('click',()=>{
document.querySelectorAll('.jocarsa-popup').forEach(x=>x.remove());let d=type==='week'?dateFromWeek(input.value):type==='time'?new Date():new Date((input.value.slice(0,10)||iso(new Date()))+'T12:00:00');if(isNaN(d))d=new Date();let y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth(),day=d.getDate();const match=(type==='time'?input.value:input.value.split('T')[1]||'').match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);let hour=match?+match[1]:12,minute=match?+match[2]:0;
const pop=document.createElement('div');pop.className='jocarsa-popup';pop.setAttribute('role','dialog');pop.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');pop.setAttribute('aria-label','Selector personalizado de '+type);document.body.append(pop);
const close=()=>{pop.remove();document.removeEventListener('pointerdown',outside);document.removeEventListener('keydown',escape);trigger.focus()};
const outside=e=>{if(!pop.contains(e.target)&&!trigger.contains(e.target))close()};const escape=e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')close()};
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',outside);document.addEventListener('keydown',escape);
function render(){pop.replaceChildren();if(type!=='time'){
const header=document.createElement('header'),prev=document.createElement('button'),next=document.createElement('button'),title=document.createElement('strong');prev.type=next.type='button';prev.textContent='‹';next.textContent='›';title.textContent=new Date(y,m,1).toLocaleDateString('es-ES',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});header.append(prev,title,next);pop.append(header);
const shift=delta=>{if(type==='month'){y+=delta;}else{const dt=new Date(y,m+delta,1);y=dt.getFullYear();m=dt.getMonth()}render()};prev.onclick=()=>shift(-1);next.onclick=()=>shift(1);
if(type==='month'){const months=document.createElement('div');months.className='jocarsa-month-grid';for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=new Date(y,i,1).toLocaleDateString('es-ES',{month:'short'});b.classList.toggle('selected',m===i);b.onclick=()=>{m=i;render()};months.append(b)}pop.append(months)}else{
const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.className='jcal-grid';['L','M','X','J','V','S','D'].forEach(t=>{const e=document.createElement('b');e.textContent=t;grid.append(e)});const offset=(new Date(y,m,1).getDay()+6)%7;
for(let i=0;i<42;i++){const date=new Date(y,m,1-offset+i),b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=date.getDate();b.classList.toggle('muted',date.getMonth()!==m);b.classList.toggle('selected',iso(date)===iso(new Date(y,m,day)));if(type==='week'&&iso(monday(date))===iso(monday(new Date(y,m,day))))b.classList.add('selected');b.onclick=()=>{y=date.getFullYear();m=date.getMonth();day=date.getDate();render()};grid.append(b)}pop.append(grid)}
}
if(type==='time'||type==='datetime-local'){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='jtime';const add=(v,max,fn,label)=>{const group=document.createElement('label');group.textContent=label;const sel=document.createElement('select');sel.setAttribute('aria-label',label);for(let i=0;i<=max;i++)sel.add(new Option(pad(i),pad(i),false,i===v));sel.onchange=()=>fn(+sel.value);group.append(sel);row.append(group)};add(hour,23,v=>hour=v,'Horas');add(minute,59,v=>minute=v,'Minutos');pop.append(row)}
const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='actions';const cancel=document.createElement('button'),ok=document.createElement('button');cancel.type=ok.type='button';cancel.textContent='Cancelar';ok.textContent='Aplicar';cancel.onclick=close;ok.onclick=()=>{const date=new Date(y,m,day);let v=iso(date);if(type==='month')v=v.slice(0,7);if(type==='week')v=weekISO(date);if(type==='time')v=`${pad(hour)}:${pad(minute)}`;if(type==='datetime-local')v+=`T${pad(hour)}:${pad(minute)}`;input.value=v;notify(input);sync();close()};actions.append(cancel,ok);pop.append(actions)}
render();const rect=trigger.getBoundingClientRect();pop.style.left=Math.max(8,Math.min(rect.left,innerWidth-pop.offsetWidth-8))+'px';pop.style.top=(rect.bottom+pop.offsetHeight+8<=innerHeight?rect.bottom+5:Math.max(8,rect.top-pop.offsetHeight-5))+'px';pop.querySelector('button')?.focus();
});}
function enhanceMulti(select){if(select.dataset.jocarsaMulti||select.disabled||!select.multiple)return;select.dataset.jocarsaMulti='1';const host=document.createElement('div');host.className='jocarsa-multidatalist';select.before(host);host.append(select);select.classList.add('jocarsa-multi-source');select.tabIndex=-1;
const selected=document.createElement('div');selected.className='jocarsa-multi-selected';const search=document.createElement('input');search.type='search';search.placeholder=select.dataset.placeholder||'Buscar y seleccionar…';search.setAttribute('aria-label','Buscar opciones');search.autocomplete='off';const list=document.createElement('div');list.className='jocarsa-multi-options';list.setAttribute('role','listbox');list.setAttribute('aria-multiselectable','true');host.append(selected,search,list);
const options=()=>[...select.options];const update=()=>{selected.replaceChildren();options().filter(o=>o.selected).forEach(o=>{const chip=document.createElement('button');chip.type='button';chip.className='jocarsa-chip';chip.textContent=o.textContent+' ×';chip.setAttribute('aria-label','Quitar '+o.textContent);chip.onclick=()=>{o.selected=false;notify(select);update();search.focus()};selected.append(chip)});selected.hidden=!selected.childElementCount;list.replaceChildren();const q=search.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('es');options().filter(o=>!o.disabled&&o.textContent.toLocaleLowerCase('es').includes(q)).forEach(o=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='jocarsa-multi-option';b.setAttribute('role','option');b.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(o.selected));b.textContent=(o.selected?'✓ ':'+ ')+o.textContent;b.onclick=()=>{o.selected=!o.selected;notify(select);update();search.focus()};list.append(b)});if(!list.childElementCount){const empty=document.createElement('p');empty.textContent='Sin resultados';list.append(empty)}};
search.addEventListener('input',update);select.addEventListener('change',update);search.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){search.value='';update();search.blur()}if(e.key==='Enter'){const first=list.querySelector('button');if(first){e.preventDefault();first.click()}}});update();}
function enhanceSegment(el){if(el.dataset.ready)return;el.dataset.ready='1';const buttons=[...el.querySelectorAll('button')];if(!buttons.length)return;const indicator=document.createElement('div');indicator.className='indicador';el.prepend(indicator);const hidden=document.createElement('input');hidden.type='hidden';hidden.name=el.getAttribute('name')||'';el.append(hidden);const storage=el.dataset.storage;function select(btn,fire=true){buttons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b===btn)));indicator.style.width=btn.offsetWidth+'px';indicator.style.transform=`translateX(${btn.offsetLeft}px)`;hidden.value=btn.dataset.valor||btn.textContent.trim();if(storage)try{localStorage.setItem(storage,hidden.value)}catch{}if(fire)notify(hidden)}buttons.forEach(b=>{b.type='button';b.onclick=()=>select(b)});let value=el.getAttribute('value');if(storage)try{value=localStorage.getItem(storage)||value}catch{};requestAnimationFrame(()=>select(buttons.find(b=>(b.dataset.valor||b.textContent.trim())===value)||buttons[0],false));if(window.ResizeObserver)new ResizeObserver(()=>{const b=buttons.find(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true');if(b)select(b,false)}).observe(el)}
function init(root=document){root.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]').forEach(el=>el.classList.add('jocarsa-switch'));root.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio]').forEach(el=>el.classList.add('jocarsa-radio'));root.querySelectorAll('input[type=date],input[type=time],input[type=datetime-local],input[type=month],input[type=week]').forEach(enhanceDate);root.querySelectorAll('select[multiple]').forEach(enhanceMulti);root.querySelectorAll('.jocarsa-segment').forEach(enhanceSegment)}
window.JocarsaEnhance={init};if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>init());else init();
})();

**jocarsa-iu.css**
```css

:root{--tono:200;--saturacion:50%;--brillo:30%;--escalon:20%;--color0:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) - var(--escalon)));--color:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),var(--brillo));--color2:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)));--color3:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)*2));--chaflan:10px}
body{font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--color3);color:#172033;margin:0}button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit} .jocarsa-control{font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif!important;border-radius:0!important;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - var(--chaflan)) 0,100% var(--chaflan),100% 100%,0 100%)}.jocarsa-barra{background:var(--color2)!important}.jocarsa-barra button,.jocarsa-cal-cabecera button{border-radius:0!important}.jocarsa-barra button.activo,.jocarsa-cal-dia.seleccionado,.jocarsa-semana-slot.seleccionado{background:var(--color)!important;color:white!important}.jocarsa-input-envoltura{border-radius:0!important}.jocarsa-input-icono{background:var(--color2)!important}
/* Mantener los controles nativos: solo apariencia de checkbox y radio */
.jocarsa-switch{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:48px;height:27px;border:1px solid #667085;border-radius:20px;background:#dbe1e6;position:relative;cursor:pointer;vertical-align:middle;transition:background .25s,box-shadow .2s}
.jocarsa-switch:before{content:'';position:absolute;width:19px;height:19px;left:3px;top:3px;border-radius:50%;background:#64748b;transition:transform .25s,background .25s}
.jocarsa-switch:checked{background:var(--color2)}.jocarsa-switch:checked:before{transform:translateX(20px);background:var(--color0)}
.jocarsa-radio{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:26px;height:26px;border:2px solid #64748b;border-radius:50%;background:white;position:relative;vertical-align:middle;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .18s,transform .18s}
.jocarsa-radio:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:50%;border-radius:50%;background:var(--color);transition:inset .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.jocarsa-radio:checked:before{inset:4px}.jocarsa-radio:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.jocarsa-switch:focus-visible,.jocarsa-radio:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color2);outline-offset:3px}
.jocarsa-popup{position:fixed;z-index:99999;width:min(350px,calc(100vw - 24px));padding:12px;background:white;border:1px solid var(--color2);box-shadow:0 14px 36px #0003;font:14px Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif}.jocarsa-popup header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--color);color:white;padding:8px}.jocarsa-popup button{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #ccd3db;background:white;padding:7px}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px;margin-top:8px}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid button{padding:7px 0}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid .selected{background:var(--color);color:white}.jocarsa-popup .jcal-grid .muted{opacity:.4}.jocarsa-popup .jtime{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0}.jocarsa-popup select{padding:8px;min-width:65px}.jocarsa-popup .actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}.jocarsa-date-trigger{padding:8px;border:1px solid #bbb;background:var(--color2);cursor:pointer}.jocarsa-date-wrap{display:inline-flex;align-items:stretch;gap:3px;max-width:100%}.jocarsa-date-wrap input{min-width:0}.jocarsa-segment{display:inline-flex;position:relative;padding:5px;background:var(--color3);isolation:isolate;gap:0}.jocarsa-segment button{z-index:1;position:relative;background:transparent;border:0;padding:12px 18px;cursor:pointer;color:#334155}.jocarsa-segment button[aria-pressed=true]{color:white}.jocarsa-segment .indicador{position:absolute;z-index:0;top:5px;left:0;height:calc(100% - 10px);background:var(--color);transition:transform .3s,width .3s;pointer-events:none}
.jocarsa-demo{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;padding:24px}.jocarsa-demo section{background:white;padding:20px;margin:16px 0}.jocarsa-demo h1{color:white}.jocarsa-demo>header{background:var(--color);padding:20px}.jocarsa-demo label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:8px}.jocarsa-demo .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:16px}.jocarsa-demo .grid>div{min-width:0}
/* v5.1: entradas semánticas con indicador a la derecha, como en el diseño original */
.jocarsa-input{max-width:100%!important;width:100%!important;clip-path:none!important}.jocarsa-input-envoltura{min-height:50px!important;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 12px) 0,100% 12px,100% 100%,0 100%);background:#f7f9fb!important;border:1px solid #b9c9d8!important}.jocarsa-input-icono{order:3;width:45px!important;flex-basis:45px!important;border-right:0!important;border-left:1px solid #c9d4e0!important;background:#e7eef4!important;color:#285775!important;font-size:13px!important;filter:none!important}.jocarsa-input-campo{order:1;font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif!important}.jocarsa-input-tipo{display:none!important}.jocarsa-input-envoltura:focus-within{border-color:#295e7b!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #8ebbd580!important}
/* El input original permanece en el formulario y almacena valores HTML estandarizados; el modal es la única interfaz visible. */

:root{--chaflan:12px;--color4:hsl(var(--tono),var(--saturacion),calc(var(--brillo) + var(--escalon)*3));}
html,body{min-height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--color3);font-family:Ubuntu,Arial,sans-serif;}

.jocarsa-demo>header h1{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 6px;}
.jocarsa-demo>header p{margin:0;opacity:.85;font-size:13px;}
.jocarsa-demo section{display:block;position:static;overflow:visible;width:auto;flex:none;color:#172033;background:#fff;padding:18px;margin:12px 0;transition:none;}
.jocarsa-demo section h2{font-size:17px;color:#173d56;margin:0 0 14px;}
.jocarsa-demo .grid{gap:12px 20px;}
.jocarsa-demo button:not(.jocarsa-date-display):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color);outline-offset:2px;}
.jocarsa-demo .jocarsa-control{max-width:100%;}
.jocarsa-demo table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;}
.jocarsa-demo thead{background:var(--color);color:white;}
.jocarsa-demo th,.jocarsa-demo td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #dce3e8;}
.jocarsa-demo pre{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
@media(max-width:680px){.jocarsa-demo{padding:8px}.jocarsa-demo section{padding:12px}.jocarsa-demo .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* Correcciones de contraste WCAG AA */

.jocarsa-date-display.empty{color:#526070!important}
.jocarsa-editor-lineas{color:#b8b8b8!important}
.jocarsa-cal-dia.otro-mes{color:#626262!important}
.jocarsa-input-ayuda{color:#626262!important}
.jocarsa-segment button{color:#27384a!important}
.jocarsa-segment button[aria-pressed=true]{color:white!important}

/* Paleta común de la interfaz */
:root{--naranja:#f97316;--azul:#1d4ed8;--blanco:#fff;--negro:#111827;--color0:var(--negro);--color:var(--azul);--color2:var(--naranja);--color3:var(--blanco)}
body{background:var(--blanco);color:var(--negro)}
.jocarsa-demo section{border:1px solid var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-demo>header,.jocarsa-popup header,.jocarsa-segment .indicador{background:var(--azul)}
.jocarsa-popup{border-color:var(--naranja)}
.jocarsa-demo .jocarsa-tabla-scroll th{background:var(--azul);color:var(--blanco)}

        .jocarsa-input{max-width:520px;overflow:visible;border:0;background:transparent;margin:8px 0}.jocarsa-input-envoltura{display:flex;align-items:stretch;width:100%;min-height:44px;border:1px solid #aaa;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}.jocarsa-input-envoltura:focus-within{border-color:#333;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}.jocarsa-input-icono{width:46px;flex:0 0 46px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#f2f2f2;border-right:1px solid #ddd;font:700 18px/1 Arial,sans-serif;color:#333;user-select:none;filter:grayscale(1)}.jocarsa-input-campo{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0!important;outline:0!important;background:transparent!important;padding:10px 12px!important;margin:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;font:15px Arial,sans-serif;color:#222}.jocarsa-input-campo::placeholder{color:#999}.jocarsa-input-tipo{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 10px;color:#888;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;user-select:none}.jocarsa-input-envoltura.invalido{border-color:#a00}.jocarsa-input-envoltura.invalido .jocarsa-input-icono{background:#fff0f0}.jocarsa-input-envoltura.valido:not(.vacio) .jocarsa-input-icono{background:#f3f7f3}.jocarsa-input[aria-disabled=true]{opacity:.55}.jocarsa-input .jocarsa-input-campo[type=color]{height:44px;padding:7px!important;cursor:pointer}.jocarsa-input .jocarsa-input-campo[type=range]{padding:0 12px!important}.jocarsa-input-ayuda{padding:4px 2px 0 48px;font-size:11px;color:#777}

    barra(){
      const barra = document.createElement("div");
      barra.className = "jocarsa-barra";
      this.raiz.appendChild(barra);
      return barra;
    }

    boton(barra, texto, fn, titulo=""){
      const b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.innerHTML = texto;
      b.title = titulo;
      b.addEventListener("click", fn);
      barra.appendChild(b);
      return b;
    }

    campoOculto(tipo="textarea"){
      const campo = document.createElement(tipo);
      campo.className = "jocarsa-hidden-input";
      if(this.name) campo.name = this.name;
      if(this.required) campo.required = true;
      if(this.disabled) campo.disabled = true;
      campo.value = this.value;
      this.raiz.appendChild(campo);
      this.campo = campo;
      return campo;
    }

    setValue(valor){
      this.value = valor;
      if(this.campo) this.campo.value = valor;
      this.raiz.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("jocarsa-change", {detail:{value:valor}}));
    }
